header: Tell us what is wrong with your till
subheader: We answer within one working day, and usually the same morning.
lead: The more you write in the form, the fewer questions we need to ask. Each follow-up question costs a day.
bodytext:
Please include your customer number, the branch and what you saw on the screen. A phone photo of the till helps more than any description.

If the till has stopped working, don't write. Call the service number and say "Ausfall" (outage), and we'll take your call first.
note: Messages sent outside office hours are answered from 8am the next working day.
